correctness.rationale: For SPD 2x2, Nyström residual A−AwwᵀA/(wᵀAw) is PSD rank one with all three unsquared norms equal to 2det(A)/(wᵀAw) for sign w. Two projective Rademacher directions yield better and worse denominators b(κ+1±(κ−1)t), worse-only probability 2^−m. Reciprocal-affine sum is strictly convex in t for κ>1, so maximal risk at t=0 or1, switched at κ+1=2^m. Uniform circular Gaussian direction integral gives benchmark b√κ; endpoint comparison yields 2^m>=1+√κ. Independent rational endpoint, direct 2x2 residual and angular integration checks, with distinct candidate-cost caveat.
